ana: heads-up — small repro for a Vite/edge break involving our JS SDK. works in node, fails when bundled for edge. :thinking_face:

ana: repro steps I used:
```bash
npx create-vite@latest repro-vite-edge --template vanilla-ts
cd repro-vite-edge
yarn add @redwood-inference/sdk
# src/main.ts imports the SDK and logs it
# run `yarn build` + simulate edge runtime
```

ana: runtime error during edge invocation: `TypeError: require is not defined` and in browser devtools `Uncaught TypeError: Failed to resolve module specifier "@redwood-inference/sdk"`

david: what is the import line? bundlers often pick cjs if exports map encourages it.

ana: `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` — package.json in the SDK seems to have main -> dist/index.cjs.js, module -> dist/index.esm.js, but exports only point to the CJS file currently.

mei: that will force rollup/vite to pull the CJS entry and then the edge runtime chokes on `require`. Also TS types: our index.d.ts uses `export =` which makes TS emit `require`-style interop in some configs.

sam: I reproduced locally with Vite 5 + esbuild transform. Build log shows plugin-commonjs converting the SDK to require() calls.

ana: tiny repro repo: https://github.com/redwood-internal/devex/vite-edge-fallback-repro (contains minimal vite config + package.json showing the issue)

ci-bot: CI run failed — repro/e2e — 2/4 tests failing. Log snippet:
```
Error: TypeError: require is not defined
    at /node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.cjs.js:1:1
```

me: short-term workaround: in Vite config add alias to the ESM build: `resolve: { alias: { '@redwood-inference/sdk': '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js' } }` — ugly but effective. Also setting `build.commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules: true` helps in some cases.

david: long-term fixes we should consider:
- publish package with `exports` mapping that prefers `./dist/index.esm.js` for import conditions and `./dist/index.cjs.js` for require;
- change typings to ESM-friendly `export default` + named exports rather than `export =` to avoid TS interop generating `require` semantics;
- audit transitive deps for CJS-only packages that might force the CJS fallback

sam: I can draft a types patch (switch to ESM-style .d.ts) and add a unit test that imports the package from an ESM-only runner. ETA: 1 day.

ana: I'll update the repro with exact npm ls output and a tiny script that demonstrates the `require is not defined` stack.

mei: david — can you check the publishing script/rollup config to ensure exports map is set correctly on release? might be just a packaging oversight.

david: on it, will check publish pipeline and `package.json` fields (main/module/exports/types). If it's indeed the exports bug I can push a patch release today.

sam: once types PR is ready I'll add a quick CI job that builds a Vite app and runs a headless check to catch regressions.

ana: also let's add a short troubleshooting note in the SDK README about bundler pitfalls (vite/webpack/rollup) and an example Vite alias until fix is published.

ci-bot: build status will re-run after patches. tagging this thread `repro:edge-vite`

ana: thanks all — reopening if the patched release still triggers plugin-commonjs fallback. :eyes:
